messages:
anne_dev: Heads-up — ran a small canary of a load-shedding knob on Mixtral moerouter (threshold=0.2). Seeing odd KV cache churn and a 3–5% tail latency regression at p95. Logs attached.

vishal_runtime: can you paste the exact config? was this on the quantized Mixtral build or the latest kernel? :thinking: 

anne_dev: Config snippet:
```
router.load_shed_threshold: 0.2
router.top_k: 4
kv.cache.max_entries: 1000000
kernel.prefetch: true
batcher.max_tokens: 2048
```
ran on mixtral-1.3-quant (kernel v3.8). Batch sizes unchanged.

sasha_research: interesting — load-shedding can change routing distribution and push more requests to cold experts which thrash the KV. Do you have per-expert hit rates and eviction counts?

anne_dev: Per-expert hit summary (top 10):
```
expert-0: 0.42
expert-1: 0.05
expert-2: 0.03
expert-3: 0.02
expert-4: 0.01
expert-5..n: <0.01
```
Cache eviction rate jumped from ~12/s to ~310/s during the window.

marco_sre: timeline check — did we also push that kernel selector affinity tweak around the same time? I remember a small scheduler patch landed yesterday.

anne_dev: Yep — kernel affinity roll 3 at 21:18 UTC. Canary ran at ~21:25.

vishal_runtime: That could be the interaction — kernel selection affects scheduling latency and preemption ordering, which can change the effective router logits distribution (due to microsecond-level timing). We should repro on v3.7 vs v3.8 locally.

sasha_research: Also try increasing `router.top_k` to 8 — that tends to spread load and reduce hot-expert pressure (at the cost of extra compute).

anne_dev: Quick follow-up test: set top_k=8 — eviction rate dropped to ~40/s and p95 returned to baseline. CPU usage increased ~12% and token cost rose slightly.

marco_sre: Good data. Sounds like a classic cache pressure vs compute tradeoff. We should consider an adaptive top_k that nudges up when hot-expert queue length > X.

vishal_runtime: Agreed. Action items: (1) run A/B comparing kernel v3.7/v3.8 with identical knobs, (2) prototype adaptive-top_k heuristic using per-expert queue length + short smoothing, (3) add KV eviction and per-expert hit-rate charts to the canary dashboard.

anne_dev: Filed quick tickets and attached traces: https://perf.internal/r/abc123 — pinging @sasha_research for the modeling work.

deploy-bot: deployment mixtral-canary-2212345678 started -> 30% traffic

sasha_research: I'll iterate on a lightweight heuristic tomorrow (start with threshold=0.15 for hot-queue ratio). For RoPE scaling side-note: when we scaled RoPE on a few Llama experiments, routing entropy changed slightly — might be worth checking for Mixtral too.

vishal_runtime: Nice point. If RoPE/head-dim changes affect token similarity, routing logits can shift. Add a unit test that runs a short prompt set and compares expert distribution before/after RoPE changes.

anne_dev: Will run local repro and drop perf trace + `perf record` output into the ticket later today.

vishal_runtime: thanks — once we have the kernel A/B and the adaptive prototype we can pick a rollout strategy.

anne_dev: 👍 will update here with traces.
